<function=python>
<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation
white = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W'][0]
print(f"White pixel after UP: {white['boundary']}")

print(f"Purple bar: {purple['pixels']} px")

# Check all blue segments

for bn in blue_nodes:
    print(f"Blue seg {bn['id']}: boundary {bn['boundary'][:4]}")

# Yellow cross boundary
yellow_cross = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'Y' and n['pixels'] > 1][0]
print(f"Yellow cross: boundary {yellow_cross['boundary'][:4]}")

# Small squares
small_y = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'Y' and n['pixels'] == 1]
small_b = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] == 1]
print(f"Small yellow: {[s['boundary'][0] for s in small_y]}")
print(f"Small blue: {[s['boundary'][0] for s in small_b]}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
